title: Bulacan's Third City
description: Meycauayan became Bulacan's third city on December 10, 2006, joining San Jose del Monte and Malolos after voters ratified its cityhood under Republic Act No. 9356.

title: A Town Since 1578
description: Franciscan friars Juan de Placencia and Diego Oropesa established Meycauayan in 1578. Its first church was made of nipa and bamboo and dedicated to St. Francis of Assisi.

title: Fine Jewelry Craftsmanship
description: Meycauayan is the historic center of the Philippines' fine-jewelry industry, carrying forward a legacy of skilled, labor-intensive craftsmanship that serves both domestic and international markets.
